## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] This pull request adds exactly one model approval bundle.
- [ ] Repository revision, weight URLs, checksums, and licenses are acceptable.
- [ ] Generated adapter, experiment, dependencies, and lockfile were reviewed.
- [ ] Dataset, task, network, secret, and disk permissions are appropriate.
- [ ] GPU type, runtime, retries, and maximum dollar budget are acceptable.
- [ ] I understand that merging approves only the exact manifest fingerprint above.

Material changes require a new bundle and another review. Merging does not
approve the scientific results; completed runs still require post-run review.
